record.bible_text: <FO><FO>Maschil<WH04905><WTH8688> of Ethan<WH0387> the Ezrahite<WH0250>.<Fo><Fo> I will sing<WH07891><WTH8799> of the mercies<WH02617> of the LORD<WH03068> for ever<WH05769>: with my mouth<WH06310> will I make known<WH03045><WTH8686> thy faithfulness<WH0530> to all<WH01755> generations<WH01755>. <RF>Maschil...: or, A Psalm for Ethan the Ezrahite, to give instruction<Rf> <RF>to all...: Heb. to generation and generation<Rf>
For I have said<WH0559><WTH8804>, Mercy<WH02617> shall be built up<WH01129><WTH8735> for ever<WH05769>: thy faithfulness<WH0530> shalt thou establish<WH03559><WTH8686> in the very heavens<WH08064>.
I have made<WH03772><WTH8804> a covenant<WH01285> with my chosen<WH0972>, I have sworn<WH07650><WTH8738> unto David<WH01732> my servant<WH05650>,
Thy seed<WH02233> will I establish<WH03559><WTH8686> for<WH05704> ever<WH05769>, and build up<WH01129><WTH8804> thy throne<WH03678> to all<WH01755> generations<WH01755>. Selah<WH05542>.<CM>
And the heavens<WH08064> shall praise<WH03034><WTH8686> thy wonders<WH06382>, O LORD<WH03068>: thy faithfulness<WH0530> also in the congregation<WH06951> of the saints<WH06918>.

For who in the heaven<WH07834> can be compared<WH06186><WTH8799> unto the LORD<WH03068>? <FI>who<Fi> among the sons<WH01121> of the mighty<WH0410> can be likened<WH01819><WTH8799> unto the LORD<WH03068>?

God<WH0410> is greatly<WH07227> to be feared<WH06206><WTH8737> in the assembly<WH05475> of the saints<WH06918>, and to be had in reverence<WH03372><WTH8737> of all <FI>them that are<Fi> about<WH05439> him.
O LORD<WH03068> God<WH0430> of hosts<WH06635>, who <FI>is<Fi> a strong<WH02626> LORD<WH03050> like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness<WH0530> round about<WH05439> thee?
Thou rulest<WH04910><WTH8802> the raging<WH01348> of the sea<WH03220>: when the waves<WH01530> thereof arise<WH07721><WTH8800>, thou stillest<WH07623><WTH8762> them.

Thou hast broken<WH01792><WH00> Rahab<WH07294> in pieces<WH01792><WTH8765>, as one that is slain<WH02491>; thou hast scattered<WH06340><WTH8765> thine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> with thy strong<WH05797> arm<WH02220>. <RF>Rahab: or, Egypt<Rf> <RF>thy...: Heb. the arm of thy strength<Rf>

The heavens<WH08064> <FI>are<Fi> thine, the earth<WH0776> also <FI>is<Fi> thine: <FI>as for<Fi> the world<WH08398> and the fulness<WH04393> thereof, thou hast founded<WH03245><WTH8804> them. <RF>the fulness...: or, all it containeth<Rf>
The north<WH06828> and the south<WH03225> thou hast created<WH01254><WTH8804> them: Tabor<WH08396> and Hermon<WH02768> shall rejoice<WH07442><WTH8762> in thy name<WH08034>.
Thou hast a mighty<WH01369> arm<WH02220>: strong<WH05810><WTH8799> is thy hand<WH03027>, <FI>and<Fi> high<WH07311><WTH8799> is thy right hand<WH03225>. <RF>a...: Heb. an arm with might<Rf>

Justice<WH06664> and judgment<WH04941> <FI>are<Fi> the habitation<WH04349> of thy throne<WH03678>: mercy<WH02617> and truth<WH0571> shall go<WH06923><WTH8762> before thy face<WH06440>. <RF>habitation: or, establishment<Rf><CM>

Blessed<WH0835> <FI>is<Fi> the people<WH05971> that know<WH03045><WTH8802> the joyful sound<WH08643>: they shall walk<WH01980><WTH8762>, O LORD<WH03068>, in the light<WH0216> of thy countenance<WH06440>.
In thy name<WH08034> shall they rejoice<WH01523><WTH8799> all the day<WH03117>: and in thy righteousness<WH06666> shall they be exalted<WH07311><WTH8799>.
For thou <FI>art<Fi> the glory<WH08597> of their strength<WH05797>: and in thy favour<WH07522> our horn<WH07161> shall be exalted<WH07311><WTH8799><WTH8675><WH07311><WTH8686>.

For the LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> our defence<WH04043>; and the Holy One<WH06918> of Israel<WH03478> <FI>is<Fi> our king<WH04428>. <RF>the LORD...: or, our shield is of the LORD, and our king is of the Holy One of Israel<Rf><CM>

Then thou spakest<WH01696><WTH8765> in vision<WH02377> to thy holy one<WH02623>, and saidst<WH0559><WTH8799>, I have laid<WH07737><WTH8765> help<WH05828> upon <FI>one that is<Fi> mighty<WH01368>; I have exalted<WH07311><WTH8689> <FI>one<Fi> chosen<WH0977><WTH8803> out of the people<WH05971>.
I have found<WH04672><WTH8804> David<WH01732> my servant<WH05650>; with my holy<WH06944> oil<WH08081> have I anointed<WH04886><WTH8804> him:
With whom my hand<WH03027> shall be established<WH03559><WTH8735>: mine arm<WH02220> also shall strengthen<WH0553><WTH8762> him.
The enemy<WH0341><WTH8802> shall not exact<WH05378><WTH8686> upon him; nor the son<WH01121> of wickedness<WH05766> afflict<WH06031><WTH8762> him.
And I will beat down<WH03807><WTH8804> his foes<WH06862> before his face<WH06440>, and plague<WH05062><WTH8799> them that hate<WH08130><WTH8764> him.
But my faithfulness<WH0530> and my mercy<WH02617> <FI>shall be<Fi> with him: and in my name<WH08034> shall his horn<WH07161> be exalted<WH07311><WTH8799>.
I will set<WH07760><WTH8804> his hand<WH03027> also in the sea<WH03220>, and his right hand<WH03225> in the rivers<WH05104>.
He shall cry<WH07121><WTH8799> unto me, Thou <FI>art<Fi> my father<WH01>, my God<WH0410>, and the rock<WH06697> of my salvation<WH03444>.
Also I will make<WH05414><WTH8799> him <FI>my<Fi> firstborn<WH01060>, higher<WH05945> than the kings<WH04428> of the earth<WH0776>.
My mercy<WH02617> will I keep<WH08104><WTH8799> for him for evermore<WH05769>, and my covenant<WH01285> shall stand fast<WH0539><WTH8737> with him.
His seed<WH02233> also will I make<WH07760><WTH8804> <FI>to endure<Fi> for ever<WH05703>, and his throne<WH03678> as the days<WH03117> of heaven<WH08064>.
If his children<WH01121> forsake<WH05800><WTH8799> my law<WH08451>, and walk<WH03212><WTH8799> not in my judgments<WH04941>;
If they break<WH02490><WTH8762> my statutes<WH02708>, and keep<WH08104><WTH8799> not my commandments<WH04687>; <RF>break: Heb. profane<Rf>
Then will I visit<WH06485><WTH8804> their transgression<WH06588> with the rod<WH07626>, and their iniquity<WH05771> with stripes<WH05061>.

Nevertheless my lovingkindness<WH02617> will I not utterly take<WH06331><WTH8686> from him, nor suffer my faithfulness<WH0530> to fail<WH08266><WTH8762>. <RF>will...: Heb. I will not make void from him<Rf> <RF>to fall: Heb. to lie<Rf>
My covenant<WH01285> will I not break<WH02490><WTH8762>, nor alter<WH08138><WTH8762> the thing that is gone out<WH04161> of my lips<WH08193>.
Once<WH0259> have I sworn<WH07650><WTH8738> by my holiness<WH06944> that I will not lie<WH03576><WTH8762> unto David<WH01732>. <RF>that...: Heb. if I lie<Rf>
His seed<WH02233> shall endure for ever<WH05769>, and his throne<WH03678> as the sun<WH08121> before me.
It shall be established<WH03559><WTH8735> for ever<WH05769> as the moon<WH03394>, and <FI>as<Fi> a faithful<WH0539><WTH8737> witness<WH05707> in heaven<WH07834>. Selah<WH05542>.<CM>
But thou hast cast off<WH02186><WTH8804> and abhorred<WH03988><WTH8799>, thou hast been wroth<WH05674><WTH8694> with thine anointed<WH04899>.
Thou hast made void<WH05010><WTH8765> the covenant<WH01285> of thy servant<WH05650>: thou hast profaned<WH02490><WTH8765> his crown<WH05145> <FI>by casting it<Fi> to the ground<WH0776>.
Thou hast broken down<WH06555><WTH8804> all his hedges<WH01448>; thou hast brought<WH07760><WTH8804> his strong holds<WH04013> to ruin<WH04288>.
All that pass by<WH05674><WTH8802> the way<WH01870> spoil<WH08155><WTH8804> him: he is a reproach<WH02781> to his neighbours<WH07934>.
Thou hast set up<WH07311><WTH8689> the right hand<WH03225> of his adversaries<WH06862>; thou hast made all his enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> to rejoice<WH08055><WTH8689>.
Thou hast also turned<WH07725><WTH8686> the edge<WH06697> of his sword<WH02719>, and hast not made him to stand<WH06965><WTH8689> in the battle<WH04421>.
Thou hast made his glory<WH02892> to cease<WH07673><WTH8689>, and cast<WH04048><WH00> his throne<WH03678> down<WH04048><WTH8765> to the ground<WH0776>. <RF>glory: Heb. brightness<Rf>
The days<WH03117> of his youth<WH05934> hast thou shortened<WH07114><WTH8689>: thou hast covered<WH05844><WTH8689> him with shame<WH0955>. Selah<WH05542>.
How long, LORD<WH03068>? wilt thou hide<WH05641><WTH8735> thyself for ever<WH05331>? shall thy wrath<WH02534> burn<WH01197><WTH8799> like fire<WH0784>?
Remember<WH02142><WTH8798> how short<WH02465> my time is: wherefore hast thou made<WH01254><WTH8804> all men<WH01121><WH0120> in vain<WH07723>?

What man<WH01397> <FI>is he that<Fi> liveth<WH02421><WTH8799>, and shall not see<WH07200><WTH8799> death<WH04194>? shall he deliver<WH04422><WTH8762> his soul<WH05315> from the hand<WH03027> of the grave<WH07585>? Selah<WH05542>.
Lord<WH0136>, where <FI>are<Fi> thy former<WH07223> lovingkindnesses<WH02617>, <FI>which<Fi> thou swarest<WH07650><WTH8738> unto David<WH01732> in thy truth<WH0530>?

Remember<WH02142><WTH8798>, Lord<WH0136>, the reproach<WH02781> of thy servants<WH05650>; <FI>how<Fi> I do bear<WH05375><WTH8800> in my bosom<WH02436> <FI>the reproach of<Fi> all the mighty<WH07227> people<WH05971>;
